description: Listen to your favorite live radio stations or create your own with iHeartRadio. iHeartRadio is "the best streaming radio app" (CNET) -- the only app you need to enjoy free music, news, talk, sports and custom radio stations created you you: LISTEN TO THE BEST OF LIVE RADIO Thousands of real radio stations playing pop, country, hip-hop and R&B, rock, talk, news, sports & more. CREATE CUSTOM MUSIC STATIONS Featuring songs from the artist you select and similar music, from our catalog of over 18 million songs by more than 450,000 artists. Log in via email or Facebook to create custom music...
